methods.label: Count individual-ball outcomes
methods.explanation: Drawing with replacement gives \(3\times3=9\) equally likely outcomes. There are \(2\times2=4\) outcomes in which both balls are red and 1 in which both are white, for a total of 5 outcomes. Player A's probability of winning is \(5/9\), which is greater than \(1/2\), so the game favors Player A.
